column4: DOES NOT APPLY TO A DATABASE THIS STORE CREATES, and is NOT A PROPERTY OF OUR DESIGN either way. The crate never states a journal mode, so the store INHERITS one from the file header: a file it creates runs on the default rollback journal (no WAL, nothing to checkpoint, and maybe_run_adaptive_autocheckpoint early-returns unless the mode is Wal), while a pre-existing WAL-mode file it is handed runs WAL with live automatic checkpointing our surface can neither drive nor observe. So whether the 3.5 checkpoint-under-load cell is even PRODUCIBLE is decided by the file, not the code. This row has carried two earlier dispositions, both wrong, both named in the evidence rather than deleted. FG-005c does not resolve as a non-claim: 5.2:148 makes an unexercised matrix cell a terminal non-pass, which prose cannot convert into a pass.

(2) fsqlite-0.3.7/src/async_api.rs:1965-1971 AsyncConnection::open delegates to open_with_env with ConnectionEnv::default().
